resolved_findings.title: Arm unmount/rmdir cleanup only after this invocation creates the workspace
resolved_findings.description: tempfn_random_child assigns workspace to a cleanup handler that recursively unmounts and removes it before mkdir_label has succeeded. If mkdir fails with EEXIST, the error exit can unmount/remove a path created by another invocation. The 64-bit random collision is unlikely, but cleanup must not mutate a path this call did not acquire.
resolved_findings.fix: Keep the candidate path under plain free cleanup until mkdir succeeds, then transfer it to the umount/rmdir cleanup variable.
resolved_findings.validation: Inject or otherwise exercise workspace mkdir EEXIST and verify the existing directory/mount remains untouched.
resolved_findings.resolution: Latest source holds candidate name under plain free cleanup and transfers it with TAKE_PTR only after mkdir_label succeeds. EEXIST now exits with workspace cleanup still NULL.
